assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: editorial illustration for a serious technical course, landscape 3:2, no text. Art direction: thoughtful independent-magazine illustration, tactile cut-paper and restrained screen printing. A substantial, balanced, asymmetrical composition occupying about 65% of the frame; generous but not excessive breathing room. Restrained palette shared across a three-cover series: warm ivory background, muted slate blue, warm gray, a small amount of faded clay/terracotta, and charcoal details. Matte flat shapes, delicate paper texture only within colored forms, a few confident hand-drawn lines. Clear shapes with subtle human irregularity. Sophisticated and approachable; visually interesting, not decorative clutter. No icons, no wireframe placeholder, no generic stock art, no gradients, no glow, no shiny 3D, no neon, no saturated colors, no robots or brains, no lettering, no labels, no symbols floating everywhere, no borders. This is conceptual editorial art, not an accurate technical schematic. Subject: language becoming structure. Several broad overlapping paper sheets form a staggered architectural stack, with small orderly ink marks representing tokens on the entering sheet and grouped blocks on the exiting sheet. Two or three flowing charcoal paths weave between the sheets. Use varying shapes and scale, muted slate-blue planes with one faded-clay plane. Make the layered arrangement feel like a crafted paper sculpture translated into a flat editorial illustration, not a small pictogram.
